## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

The *Cakkhu Sutta* (“The Eye”, Iti 61; PTS It 52) is a discourse in the *Tikanipāta* (Book of the Threes) of the *Itivuttaka*. The sutta presents a concise threefold classification of eyes: the physical eye of flesh (*maṁsacakkhu*), the clairvoyant divine eye (*dibbacakkhu*), and the eye of discernment or wisdom (*paññācakkhu*) [Vasubandhu 1991].

In addition, DharmaNexus identifies shared phrasing between Iti 61 and ten other *Itivuttaka* discourses (most extensively Iti 64, Iti 66, Iti 67, and Iti 60), representing the standard structural and opening formulas common to discourses in the collection [DharmaNexus].
